To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the accounting information system (AIS) of the company is an important factor in explaining the company’s financial performance; (ii) the AIS of the company is positively associated with the company’s financial success, measured by ROA, ROE and the market-to-book ratio; (iii) the AIS of a company has a significant impact on its financial success, even when controlling for the size and industry of the company, the accounting policy choice, and the quality of earnings.
The accounting information systems (AIS) literature is dominated by the AIS research community in the U.S. and the U.K., with a few exceptions.
